newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse confident on 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse confident on 1996 profit rise.

text.p: Swiss aluminium, packaging and chemicals group Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG said it was cautiously optimistic for the rest of 1996 and was confident that full-year results would exceed those of 1995.
Alusuisse also said in its interim report that it did not expect to change its current dividend policy.
The forecast followed one made in February when Alusuisse said it expected 1996 results to at least match those of 1995, barring unexpected developments.
Alusuisse reported a 1995 group net profit of 385 million Swiss francs, up from 207 million in 1994.

"If current trading conditions continue until the end of the year, and some stability is re-achieved in the metals market, we have confidence that our group will exceed 1995 results," the Alusuisse statement said.
